svg.title: Contoso Motors agent collaboration architecture
svg.desc: Microsoft Teams uses the native authenticated Activity route to the Foundry Hosted Router. The local Python requester calls API Management using a Bearer token obtained with a certificate. The Router discovers capabilities in API Center and calls APIM specialist routes. APIM uses shared delegated credentials for the Copilot Studio supplier and managed identity for the Foundry logistics Prompt Agent. The workload VNet contains Hosted, private endpoint and External APIM subnets. Shared Azure services appear below the network.

text.tspan: Governed agent collaboration across Teams, Foundry and Copilot Studio
Private project APIs | Scoped public Activity exception
